title: Tavakai, the Chieftain Boss Guide: All Three Forms, Arena Hazards and Phase Fixes
summary: Path of Exile 2 Act 4 final boss guide: Tavakai's three forms, the run to the second arena, Ancestor Blessings and phase-transition fixes.
description: Beat Tavakai, the Chieftain in PoE2 Act 4. Three forms (Chieftain, Fallen, Consumed), arena blessings, phase-transition states, and recovery from stuck phases.
author: Exile2 Guides Editorial Team
imageAlt: Tavakai, the Chieftain — Act 4 boss fight still

sections.title: Remember These First
sections.callout: Tavakai, the Chieftain is the Act 4 final boss. The three names (Chieftain / Fallen / Consumed) are forms of ONE fight, not three separate bosses.
calloutDetail: He runs to a second arena between forms — do not think he despawned or that you won early.
In the Consumed form, Ancestor Blessings change the safe zones; watch the ground, not just the boss.
If a phase stalls (boss invulnerable, not moving), it is usually a transition beat — keep damaging the correct target and wait.

answers.label: Three forms?
answers.text: One fight, Chieftain then Fallen then Consumed

answers.label: Runs away?
answers.text: He transitions to a second arena mid-fight

answers.label: If stuck
answers.text: Keep attacking; respawn only if truly softlocked

sections.title: Top search questions: forms, transitions, progress

items.question: Is Tavakai the Act 4 final boss?
answer: Yes. He is the climax of Act 4 and gates progression into the Interludes.

items.question: Are Chieftain / Fallen / Consumed three bosses?
answer: No. They are three forms of the same fight, triggered by HP thresholds and a mid-fight arena transition.

items.question: Why did he run to a new arena?
answer: Between the Chieftain and Fallen forms he crosses to a stone circular arena. Follow him; the fight is not over.

items.question: Why is he suddenly invulnerable?
answer: Transitions make him briefly untargetable or immune. That is normal; keep positioning and wait for the next form to open.

steps.label: Reach Heart of the Tribe
body: Progress through Act 4 to the Heart of the Tribe zone.

steps.label: Trigger the fight
body: Enter the arena to start the Chieftain form.

steps.label: Follow the transition
body: After the first form, cross to the second arena for the Fallen form.

sections.title: Three-Form Overview
paragraphs: Tavakai fights as three escalating forms: the Chieftain opens with hook and slam combos, the Fallen appears after he crosses to a stone arena with a Corrupted Barrage and Jade Sunder, and the Consumed adds periodic hazards and Ancestor Blessings in the final stretch.
All three are the same boss. The mid-fight run to the second arena is the single biggest source of confusion — players who stop attacking assume the fight ended.
bullets: Chieftain: hook + three-slam combo, punish after big skills.
Fallen: Corrupted Barrage + Jade Sunder, hit from behind the barrage.
Consumed: Spikefield + rotating Ancestor Blessings, short windows after hazards clear.

sections.title: Arena and Ancestor Blessings
paragraphs: The fight spans two arenas: an open first arena and a stone circular second arena. In the Consumed form, Ancestor Blessings (Tawhoa's, Ramako's, Arohongui's) periodically mark safe and dangerous zones.
Each Blessing has a visual tell, a danger area, and a move direction. The safe spot shifts, so keep reading the ground rather than locking onto the boss.
bullets: Tawhoa's Blessing: avoid the indicated strike zone, move to the flank.
Ramako's Blessing: light-based hazard, keep to covered sides.
Arohongui's Blessing: reposition as the safe ring moves.
Never only watch the boss — the edges decide your safety.

phases.label: Form 1 — Chieftain (100%–~66%)
notes: Hook and three-slam combo; punish after the big wind-up.

phases.label: Form 2 — Fallen (~66%–~33%)
phases.trigger: He crosses to the stone arena.
notes: Corrupted Barrage and Jade Sunder; hit from behind the barrage.

phases.label: Form 3 — Consumed (~33%–0%)
notes: Spikefield and rotating Ancestor Blessings; burst in short post-hazard windows.

attacks.name: Hook
telegraph: A long hook wind-up toward your position.
responses: Side-step the hook; do not backroll into a wall.

attacks.name: Rolling Slam (x3)
responses: Punish in the gap after the third slam.
notes: The combo end is your damage window.

attacks.name: Corrupted Barrage
responses: Move to the side or behind the barrage cone.
commonMistakes: Standing in front of the cone

attacks.name: Spikefield
responses: Use the short window after spikes retract to burst.

attacks.name: Ancestor Blessing
responses: Read the tell and move to the safe ring.

sections.title: Phase Transition States
paragraphs: Between forms Tavakai is briefly untargetable or immune and may cross to the second arena. This is intended — a high-burst build that skips a form too fast can make the next form feel abrupt, but it is not a bug.
If he appears stuck (not moving, no progress) after a kill, first confirm you followed him to the new arena. A true softlock is rare; respawn at checkpoint only if the arena never updates.
bullets: Follow him across arenas; the fight continues.
Respawn only on a confirmed softlock.

items.label: Capped Chaos Resistance
items.why: Corrupted Barrage and Blessings deal Chaos.
items.fix: Chaos rolls, charm, or corrupted gear.

items.label: Movement speed
items.why: You must cross arenas and dodge Blessings.

sections.title: Build Considerations
paragraphs: Tavakai rewards burst during the short windows after each form's big skill. Sustained damage alone drags the fight and lets Blessings pile up.
Melee can punish slam combos up close; ranged must respect the Corrupted Barrage cone and keep mobile for Blessings.
bullets: Melee: punish after the three-slam combo.
Ranged: stay behind the barrage cone, kite Blessings.
Burst builds shine in the Consumed windows.
Avoid standing still for any Blessing.

entries.question: He ran away and the fight ended?
summary: Players report Tavakai crossing to a second arena and assume a win.
editorialAnalysis: This is the intended mid-fight transition, not a bug or early win.
officialAnswer: Follow him to the second arena; the fight continues through three forms.

entries.question: Boss is stuck and will not progress
summary: Forum posts note a stalled phase after a fast kill.
editorialAnalysis: Usually a transition beat; confirm you followed him, then respawn only if softlocked.
officialAnswer: Keep attacking the correct form; respawn at checkpoint on a confirmed softlock.

problems.symptom: He ran to a new arena and I stopped
directAnswer: Follow him; it is the Fallen form transition, not a win.
checks: Is his health still above zero?

problems.symptom: He is invulnerable and not moving
directAnswer: Wait through the transition; keep attacking the correct form.
Read each Blessing tell and move to the safe ring; do not watch only the boss.
checks: Are you inside the danger zone?
